newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee ends at new low on lack of dollars.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee ends at new low on lack of dollars.

text.p: A dearth of dollars led the Sri Lanka rupee to close at a new low of 57.16 to the dollar on Monday after opening at 57.11.
The previous closing low was also 57.11, on Friday.
"The dollar rose mainly due to a lack of sellers," said a Deutsche Bank dealer.
Some dealers said the shortage of dollars was caused by banks with long dollar positions not willing to unwind, while others said no one had excess of the U.S. unit.
